```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
sales_df <- read_csv("data/week1_sales.csv")
```

## Scatter plot

```{r}
plot_scatter <- ggplot(sales_df, aes(quantity, price, color = category)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Price vs Quantity", x = "Quantity", y = "Price") +
  theme_minimal()
plot_scatter

ggsave("plot_scatter.png", plot_scatter, width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Bar plot

```{r}
plot_bar <- sales_df %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(category, mean_price, fill = category)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Average Price by Category", x = NULL, y = "Mean Price") +
  theme_minimal()
plot_bar

ggsave("plot_bar.png", plot_bar, width = 6, height = 4)
```
